name: Eógan of Connacht

attributes.attribute: king of Connacht who wanted the upright burial
dug up the body and turned it other way

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: A king of Connacht named Eógan asked to be buried standing. He wanted to face the land of his enemies in death. His spirit could then go on guarding his own land. But his enemies dug up the body and buried it the other way.

okr.objective: Rewrite the Eógan of Connacht burial entry.
key_results: Record the request to be buried standing
State the aim to shield his land
Record that enemies reburied him another way
